parts.summary: Notice how Jehovah's treatment of Moab shows both justice and mercy.

mission.title: One thought to keep

Notice an example or scripture connected to that idea.
Draw it or keep it in your own words. You can also just listen.

parts.title: Spiritual gems
parts.question: Explore the juniper-tree comparison in Jeremiah 48:6. What does it convey about Moab's situation?
parts.summary: Consider the verse-specific question, then keep a separate discovery from Jeremiah 47-48.
